title: The Malevolent Force
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ The Malevolent Force

beats.name: A. 50p
beats.blurb: A loaf of bread costs 50p. Already wrong somehow: horror-film dread in a corner shop.

beats.name: B. £1 → £5
beats.blurb: The next day £1, then £5, the shop darker each time; something unseen is in there.

beats.name: C. £50
beats.blurb: £50. The ghost is inflation: the money printer in the hands of whoever decides that day, never seen.

moodboard_intro: Round 1 (clean room: a sealed writer researched The Conjuring 2 and supernatural horror stills, UK corner shops at night and Nano Banana 2, nothing from the repo). Nine looks, none repeated: 35mm tungsten / linocut / infrared CCTV for 50p; disposable flash / stop-motion felt / 1950s pulp comic for £1→£5; fridge-lit anamorphic / 1920s spirit photograph / 1980s VHS box for £50. The force is never a face. The Fredo-style bar is the running joke. Vote This / Maybe / No per still and note any beat.
